definitions.gloss: way home, way back, return path
definitions.explanation: The route taken when returning home or going back to where one came from. Also used to describe the journey itself.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}にコンビニに{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: I stopped at a convenience store on the way home.

examples.japanese: {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}で{雨|あめ}に{降|ふ}られた。
examples.english: I got caught in the rain on the way home.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}からの{帰|かえ}り{道|みち}に、{友達|ともだち}と{夕焼|ゆうや}けを{見|み}ながら{歩|ある}いたのがいい{思|おも}い{出|で}だ。
examples.english: Walking home from school while watching the sunset with friends is a fond memory.

notes:
USAGE:
The opposite is {行|い}きの{道|みち} or {行|ゆ}く{道|みち} (the way there). Often used with the particle に to mean "on the way home": {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}に. Can also be used figuratively to mean there is no turning back: {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}はない.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}に: on the way home
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}で: on the way back
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}を{急|いそ}ぐ: to hurry on the way home
- {帰|かえ}り{道|みち}に{迷|まよ}う: to get lost on the way back
